project.title: Metagenomes and metatranscriptomes of a nitric oxide-reducing enrichment culture
project.description: A continuous bioreactor inoculated with denitrifying sludge is constantly fed with nitric oxide and formate, and the resulting NO-reducing enrichment culture is characterized based on metagenomic and metatranscriptomic analyses.
